Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental factual error in comparing the masses of subatomic particles. It incorrectly stated that the proton (approx. 1.67e-27 kg) has less mass than the electron (approx. 9.11e-27 kg). In reality, the electron is significantly lighter than the proton (roughly 1/1836th the mass). Consequently, the Planner concluded that the proton has the least mass, whereas the correct answer is the electron. This error represents a misinterpretation of scientific data and incorrect application of physics principles regarding atomic mass, matching the error signature seen in Example 2.
